reference.source: Thomas Bulkowski, The Pattern Site — Bullish Hikkake (Encyclopedia of Candlestick Charts entry)
reference.quote: Look for an inside day (lower high and higher low compared to the prior day) followed by a lower high and lower low.

draw.today: 49 words — `hikkake` (34px), 29 teal under the low / 20 red over the high — 51 uncapped fires (10.3% of bars). Every marked bar follows an inside bar and breaks one of its extremes, which is the middle of the reference's figure; the bar we mark is the FALSE break, painted teal exactly when the reference says the pattern is not yet a pattern. 27 of 49 pairs sit within 21px, newest at x 1082 running into the gutter.
draw.canonical: the mark lands only after confirmation — price must return above the inside day's high within three bars, and until then the reference has no signal to draw

fires.our_rule: prev inside pp (prev.high < pp.high && prev.low > pp.low) && ((last.high < prev.high && last.low < prev.low) => Buy | (last.high > prev.high && last.low > prev.low) => Sell) (candlesticks.rs:247-255) — 51 fires; no confirmation clause, no three-bar window, and the two-sided break of the inside bar's own extremes is not the reference's trigger
fires.their_rule: an inside day, then a false break of it, then confirmation: price must rise above the inside day's high in three days or less, after the candle ends, before the pattern counts

rule_as_data.rule: inside(prev, pp) && break_below(prev, last) => mark(bar = n, side = bullish) [reference: confirmed only if a later bar closes above inside.high within 3 bars]

warmup.before: detect_candlesticks returns nothing under 2 candles (candlesticks.rs:48), so bar 0 draws nothing; the single confirming bar carries one word and no glyph — the hikkake block is behind candlesticks.rs:132, so the three-bar block sits behind the early return at candlesticks.rs:132, so bars 0-1 draw nothing, and the confirming third bar carries one word: formed_at is None (candlesticks.rs:67) so the wire says bars:[t,t] and the two pattern bars that make the pattern stay unmarked
